newsitem.title: USA: Daschle says US short-term funds bill more likely.
newsitem.headline: Daschle says US short-term funds bill more likely.

text.p: Senate Democratic Leader Tom Daschle said Thursday there was a greater likelihood that Congress would have to pass a short-term bill funding much of the government for a few days while legislative problems were being ironed out.

"There is now a greater likelihood" that such a bill would be necessary, Daschle told reporters. He said Republicans had sent a bill, called a continuing resolution, to the White House but "large sections" were missing. Daschle said he believed Congress would not be able to adjourn this weekend as planned but would have to return to complete work on Monday.
